station_name: East Walker River above Strosnider ditch, near Mason, Nev.
township_range_section: NW¼SW¼ sec.14, T.11 N., R.26 E.
notes: Daily discharge, water year October 1967 to September 1968. Location paragraph also gives: on right bank 0.8 mile upstream from head of Strosnider ditch, 12 miles southeast of Mason, and 13.5 miles southeast of Yerington. No county on the page.
